2609.05334.title: Lightweight Vision Transformer Compression for On-Device Plant Disease Detection in Resource-Constrained Agricultural Field Conditions
2609.05334.paper_summary: Chilli (Capsicum annuum) is one of India's most economically significant crops, yet its productivity is persistently threatened by diseases that are difficult to identify without expert intervention. While Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved high classification accuracy, their large computational footprint makes deployment on resource constrained devices challenging. Existing compression approaches typically address pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation in isolation, leaving the potential benefits and interactions of their combined application insufficiently explored. We propose a unified Vision Transformer compression framework that combines Hessian-Balanced Adaptive Block Pruning (H-BAC), guided by second-order sensitivity estimation, with quantization and attention-based knowledge distillation. To systematically identify the most effective configuration within each compression family, each technique is first evaluated independently through controlled ablation studies, after which the best-performing components are integrated into a sequential deployment pipeline tailored to real-world agricultural constraints. On a chilli 3-class village-split dataset with a genuine cross-village, cross-device out-of-distribution test split, the resulting compressed models match or exceed the 95.13% FP32 baseline's accuracy, alongside 74-98% model size reduction, and the fully integrated compression pipeline achieves a 54.5x size reduction (327.42 MB to 6.01 MB) at 95.13 +/- 2.32% accuracy across four tested configurations. A direct comparison further reveals that, on this dataset, a directly-trained student of the same final size, without pruning or distillation, reaches comparable accuracy of 94.87%, at the same 6.01 MB INT8 size, indicating where H-BAC and knowledge distillation are, and are not yet shown to be, worth their computational cost.
2609.05334.paper_summary_zh: 辣椒 (Capsicum annuum) 是印度最具經濟意義的作物之一，但其生產力持續受到難以識別的疾病威脅，這需要專家的介入。儘管視覺轉換器 (ViTs) 已經實現了高分類準確率，但其龐大的計算需求使得在資源受限的設備上部署變得具有挑戰性。現有的壓縮方法通常單獨處理修剪、量化和知識蒸餾，這使得它們的聯合應用的潛在好處和相互作用尚未得到充分探索。我們提出了一個統一的視覺轉換器壓縮框架，結合了由二階靈敏度估計指導的海森平衡自適應區塊修剪 (H-BAC)、量化和基於注意力的知識蒸餾。為了系統地識別每個壓縮家族中最有效的配置，每種技術首先通過控制性消融研究獨立評估，然後將表現最佳的組件整合到一個針對現實農業限制量身定制的序列部署管道中。在一個辣椒三類村莊分割數據集上，該數據集具有真正的跨村莊、跨設備的分佈外測試分割，所得到的壓縮模型的準確率達到或超過 95.13% 的 FP32 基準準確率，並實現了 74-98% 的模型大小減少，而完全整合的壓縮管道在四個測試配置下實現了 54.5 倍的大小減少 (從 327.42 MB 減少到 6.01 MB)，準確率為 95.13 +/- 2.32%。進一步的直接比較顯示，在這個數據集上，沒有修剪或蒸餾的同一最終大小的直接訓練學生達到了相當的準確率 94.87%，在相同的 6.01 MB INT8 大小下，這表明 H-BAC 和知識蒸餾在計算成本上是值得的地方和尚未顯示的地方。
